event.description: Extend the rank-5 tied token-factorization candidate from 45000 to 75000 steps while preserving its prior cosine trajectory through step 45000 and continuing at the 1e-4 learning-rate floor.
event.proposal: Family: training control. Retained incumbent is attempt-0051 with 2944 parameters at 99.440000%, a +0.440000 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family history: the most recent accepted result is attempt-0025, whose extended 45000-step learning-rate-floor condition qualified the rank-7 positional factorization at 3381 parameters and 99.89%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0018, whose 45000-step floor retry of fixed-basis positions remained an optimization failure; 2 prior training-control attempts. The immediate precursor for this exact rank-5 token candidate is attempt-0052, an optimization failure after 45000 steps with validation still rising but only 98.30% at the endpoint; its archived log justifies a changed-condition retry rather than a silent retry. Hypothesis: the rank-5 tied token subspace may cross the checkpoint gate with additional constant-floor optimization after its observed late learning. This is a training-control change, not a parameterization-preserving compression or representational change: it keeps the 2915-parameter rank-5 architecture fixed while preserving the previous schedule through step 45000 and adds 30000 steps at 1e-4. It is more informative than changing token rank or learning rate immediately because it isolates whether the unscored boundary was training duration rather than token-subspace capacity.
